content:
Based on the description, Indiabulls Real Estate appears to be primarily a B2C (Business-to-Consumer) company. 

Key indicators:
- The company develops residential projects, which are typically sold directly to individual homebuyers
- They develop commercial and office projects which can be sold or leased to individual businesses or consumers
- They focus on creating real estate properties for end-users (consumers) rather than solely serving other businesses

While they may have some B2B interactions (such as with construction suppliers, contractors, or potentially selling entire commercial properties to businesses), their primary business model seems oriented towards selling real estate directly to individual consumers.

So the classification would be: B2C (with some potential B2B elements)
